params.title: Salmon Salad
params.body:
Ingredients:
- 1 cup cooked chickpeas
- 1/2 cup tahini
- 1/4 cup lemon juice
- {ingredient_quantity} {ingredient}
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1/4 teaspoon cumin

Instructions:
1. In a food processor, combine cooked chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin.
2. Process until smooth and creamy.
3. Transfer hummus to a serving bowl.
4. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika before serving.

fields.directions: Mix cooked quinoa with diced vegetables, feta cheese, and a lemon olive oil dressing. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Eggplant Parmesan
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Slice eggplant, bread, and fry. Layer in a baking dish with marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese. Bake until bubbly. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Butternut Squash Soup
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Sauté onions and garlic, add cubed butternut squash and broth. Puree until smooth and season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Pesto Pasta with Peas
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Cook pasta, stir in pesto sauce and cooked peas. Add Parmesan cheese before serving. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Toss cooked noodles with a Thai peanut sauce, sliced red bell peppers, cabbage, carrots, and cilantro. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Veggie and Hummus Sandwich
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Spread hummus on bread, add cucumber, bell pepper, carrot, and lettuce. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Salmon with Dill Sauce
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Bake salmon fillets and serve with a sauce made from Greek yogurt, dill, lemon juice, and garlic. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Stuff chicken breasts with a mixture of spinach, feta, garlic, and herbs. Bake until chicken is cooked through. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Mix cooked quinoa, black beans, corn, tomato sauce, and spices. Stuff into bell peppers and bake until tender. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Caprese Salad Skewers
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Thread cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, and mozzarella balls onto skewers. Drizzle with balsamic glaze. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Vegetable Stir Fry with Tofu
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Stir-fry tofu cubes until golden, add assorted vegetables and a stir-fry sauce. Serve over rice or noodles. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Quick Fried Rice
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Sauté cooked rice with vegetables, add soy sauce and scrambled eggs. Toss until hot. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Mix shredded cooked chicken with BBQ sauce. Place on tortillas with cheese, fold and cook until crispy. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Shrimp Avocado Salad
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Mix cooked shrimp with avocado, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion. Dress with lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Greek Salad Pita Pockets
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Fill pita pockets with lettuce, cucumber, tomato, feta, olives, and Greek dressing. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Chicken Caesar Salad Wrap
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Toss chopped romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing, grilled chicken strips, and Parmesan cheese. Wrap in a large tortilla. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Chickpea Vegetable Soup
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Sauté onions, carrots, and celery, add broth, canned tomatoes, and chickpeas. Simmer with spinach and seasonings. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Sausage and Peppers Skillet
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Sauté sliced sausage, bell peppers, and onions until browned. Serve with mustard or on a hoagie roll. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

fields.title: Turkey and Cheese Panini
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Layer turkey and cheese on bread, grill in a panini press until golden. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Mango Chicken Curry
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Cook chicken pieces in a pan, add onions, garlic, and ginger. Stir in curry powder, coconut milk, and mango pieces. Simmer until chicken is cooked. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Cook fettuccine pasta, toss with Alfredo sauce and grilled chicken strips. Serve with a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Spicy Tuna Wraps
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Mix canned tuna with mayo and sriracha. Spread on tortillas, add lettuce and cucumber slices, roll up. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Cauliflower Fried "Rice"
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice. Sauté with vegetables, soy sauce, and add scrambled eggs. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Sauté onions, garlic, carrots, and spices. Add canned chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Simmer until flavors meld. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
fields.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
fields.directions: Roast sweet potato cubes, mix with black beans, and use as filling for tacos. Top with avocado and cilantro lime sauce. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
fields.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
fields.directions: Top sliced baguette with a mix of chopped tomatoes, basil, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

fields.title: Beef Stir Fry
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Stir-fry beef slices with broccoli, bell peppers, and onions in soy sauce and garlic. Serve over rice or noodles. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

fields.title: Lentil Soup
fields.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
fields.directions: Cook onions, carrots, celery, garlic, and lentils in vegetable broth until lentils are tender. Season with thyme and bay leaves. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
